name: Fabric capacity
short_description: A shared pool of Microsoft Fabric compute measured in capacity units (CUs) that workspaces and items draw from; consumption is smoothed over time and sustained overuse can lead to throttling.

evidence.quote: Fabric expresses shared compute resources in capacity units or C use.
use the Fabric Capacity Metrics app to investigate that demand.
A capacity is a pool of compute
Microsoft measures that bucket in capacity units
It needs a fabric capacity, which is a paid pool of computing power
